artists.source_line: Make the cheque payable to ASS SMOOTH DANCES and send it to:

features.rationale: The 620 euro full pass explicitly includes full-board accommodation.

features.quote: Full board applies to all prices offered.
features.rationale: Full board is applied to all prices, so meals are included in the packages.

features.quote: at the Alhambra Hotel in Santa Susanna
features.rationale: The event is held at the same hotel where the dancers are invited to stay.
The program lists a pool party.

features.quote: Classes will be held every day from 11:30 am to 12:30 pm
features.rationale: Daily dance classes are part of the event program.

features.quote: Take a shuttle via http://www.shuttledirect.com and follow the instructions
features.rationale: The description gives shuttle options from the airport to the hotel.
